name: Paribus pETH redeem reentrancy
summary: The Paribus native-ETH market sent ether to the redeemer before the comptroller's collateral bookkeeping was updated, so the receive hook re-entered the protocol and borrowed against collateral that had already been withdrawn.
notes: pETH is a Compound-style delegator whose implementation is stored in nonstandard slot 18. Its creation receipt emits NewImplementation(0x0, 0x5b0ec471565e36e5a33c35b861dd752e16f3a8e7); slot 18 is zero one block earlier and selects that implementation at creation and immediately before the incident. No later NewImplementation event exists before the incident, and both delegator and implementation runtimes are unchanged. Proxy creation is therefore the implementation's canonical activation and latest age reset for this market.

Gross loss is exact net depletion of the three implicated Paribus markets in the successful anchor receipt. pETH receives 200 ETH and sends 213.075471156453514228 ETH, for 13.075471156453514228 ETH net depletion; its archive balance falls from 13.075471156463824220 ETH to 0.000000000010309992 ETH. pUSDT receives 30,000 USDT and sends 50,122.071155 USDT, for 20,122.071155 USDT net depletion; pWBTC receives no WBTC and sends its full 0.75523112 WBTC balance. Both token archive balances fall exactly to zero. Flash-liquidity inputs are included in the market inflows; repayments and downstream swaps occur outside the victim markets and return no value to them. USDT is valued at par. The closest preceding DefiLlama points are ETH at $1,919.93 at 1681207964, 168 seconds before the anchor, and BTC at $30,072 at 1681207971, 161 seconds before it. Exact component values total $67,937.3707330498, replacing the seed's rounded $86,000 estimate.
